canonical_control_rewrite.reason: Actual QCP probes elide certain UInt32-to-SInt32/expression casts and produce false targets; explicit bounded arithmetic avoids this frontend gap without changing either ISA primitive interpretation.
canonical_control_rewrite.scope: Only the repaired RVV count and NEON SRSHL count; no other scalar/instruction operand substituted; all raw int32 values retained.
